summary: Verified the PostMePlex AI-character date/time awareness fix via backend-only tests on the sync voice-turn endpoint. 3/3 pytest cases pass. Replies correctly reflect the REAL local date/day/time for both America/New_York and Asia/Tokyo (Tokyo correctly rolls to the next calendar day) and the correct upcoming Sunday (Oct 25, 2026 at test time). No stale 'October 11' date appears. The authoritative _now_context block (today, local time, tomorrow, upcoming Sunday, 'never state a different date') is intact in ai_characters.py and is prepended to _reply + _media_reply.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_characters.py is now ~1550 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. The date/time fix is clean, but a future split (prompts, scheduling, reply_loop, routes) is overdue.

Previous iteration (56) flagged a reply_loop retry-forever bug on media-reply failure — not reverified here (out of scope). Still relevant: _replies_once exception path should $unset pending_reply_at (ai_characters.py:~1177).

_now_context prepends to context on every call — if _reply is called in a hot loop (proactive_loop ticks), consider caching the string for the current minute to avoid rebuilding on every tick; cosmetic only.
test_credentials: Super-admin PIN: identifier=semidiepie pin=7455 (POST /api/auth/login-pin) — access_token used as Bearer.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing AI character 'Nova' (first in list). If no character existed, test would create a TEST_DateBot and auto-delete it (not triggered this run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_datetime_awareness.py uses the SYNC /voice-turn endpoint (deterministic) and reuses the first existing character. Date-fact assertions are robust to both digit times ('2:55 PM') and spelled-out times ('two fifty five in the afternoon'). Hour tolerance is ±1 for latency. If re-running near midnight local, the day-after-next assertion still holds (test computes expected values at run time). The fix also covers /send (deferred reply), proactive messages, media replies, and live comments — all go through _reply / _media_reply which prepend _now_context from stored state.tz.
rca of the issue: Pre-fix: character replies had no server-authoritative current date/time; the model guessed and anchored to a stale date (user saw 'October 11'). Fix: _now_context(tz) in /app/backend/routes/ai_characters.py:40-68 computes today's full date, weekday, local time, tomorrow and the upcoming Sunday from the stored IANA tz and prepends it to the system/context of every _reply + _media_reply call (also used by voice_turn at :904-909). voice_turn also writes body.tz into ai_char_state so the context is persistent for later deferred replies. Verified end-to-end: replies now explicitly state the correct weekday+month+day+year+local time and the correct upcoming Sunday, in BOTH America/New_York and Asia/Tokyo (Tokyo correctly rolls to next calendar day).
